column1: # Screenshot tour stops (Revival.ScreenshotTour.cs, docs/ai/tasks/screenshot-tour.md).
# One stop per line, fields separated by tabs or spaces, the note is the rest:
#   name  x  z  height  yaw  pitch  hour  world  note
# name: [A-Za-z0-9_-], the JPG file name. x, z: world position (x east, z north).
# height: 0 = on the ground; more = dropped from that height onto the first
# collider below (a roof, a tower cab). yaw: 0 north, 90 east. pitch: degrees,
# positive looks up. hour: 0..24 or - (keep). world: west (GW_Scene_1) or east
# (needs [World] EastTile, else skipped).
# Add a stop: append a line, keep the name unique. Coordinates of the airfield
# pieces: docs/ai/tasks/airfield-greybox.md section 1; runway: east-runway.md.
